passive.name: Blade's End
passive.description: Talon's spells Wound champions and large monsters, stacking up to 3 times. When Talon attacks a champion with 3 stacks of Wound, they bleed for heavy damage over time.

spells.name: Noxian Diplomacy
spells.description: Talon leaps to a target and deals physical damage. If used in melee range, this Ability instead critically strikes for physical damage. If this Ability kills the target, Talon restores Health and refunds % of its Cooldown.
spells.coverageNote: CommunityDragon calculation LeapDamage was preserved. Stateful and alternate effects require an explicit module.

spells.name: Shadow Assault
spells.description: Talon disperses a ring of blades that deal physical damage, gains % Move Speed, and becomes Invisible for seconds. When the Invisibility ends, the blades return to Talon, dealing physical damage again. If Talon cancels the Invisibility with an Attack or with Noxian Diplomacy, the blades return to the target instead.
